title: The X-Ray Attack
concept: An x-ray attack is when a rook, bishop or queen acts through an enemy piece on the same line — either defending its own piece or attacking one beyond it.
tip: Follow the line of your long-range piece straight through an enemy piece. What is on the far side?

feedback.correct: Sharp! Your piece saw straight through the enemy piece on that line — an x-ray.
feedback.hint: Line up your rook, bishop or queen so its power reaches through an enemy piece.
feedback.reveal: The long-range piece works through the enemy piece on the line, defending or winning what lies beyond it.
